# P32.10 — Implement design-aware resolution evaluation and safe eligibility

**Requirement ids:** SIG-EVAL-003, SIG-EVAL-004 (§55.4) · **ADR:** ADR-129 ·
**Base:** `devin/p32-9-human-evaluation-protocol-and-packets` (stacked on PR #164 — merge this after #164) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/170_P32.10__resolution-evaluator-and-confidence-gates.md live_verification=false`

## What this does

Ships the **measurement + shadow-gate** half of the S3 human-evaluation design
(P32.9 landed the campaign machinery). A new pure, deterministic, stdlib-only
`resolution/evaluator.py` computes what the preregistered confidence gate
*would* decide over released reference labels — and applies nothing.

### Separate estimands, never pooled (SIG-EVAL-003)

Every `EstimandReport` carries numerator, denominator, rows, named population,
method and an explicit `measured | partial | unavailable` state:

- **auto-positive precision** — strict verified-`same` share per
  (tier, scope, stratum); every non-success category counted.
- **candidate recall** — over *independently referenced* same pairs only; a
  sample of the matcher's own candidates reports
  `unavailable / candidate_only_frame` (it cannot observe blocking false
  negatives); undecided reference units enter the strict lower denominator.
- **cluster quality** — pairwise + B-cubed over entities with reference-cluster
  membership; a pair-only sample reports `unavailable`; unlabeled entities stay
  in coverage — never invented truth singletons.
- **labelability** — decisive share per stratum; abstentions counted.

### Inference follows the declared design (SIG-EVAL-004)

- `clopper_pearson_lower` (exact one-sided binomial inversion) exists **only**
  under a declared `independent_bernoulli` design — which requires
  `equal_probability`, item independence, a *recorded* independence basis, and
  no shared dependency groups. Correlated/enriched samples can never select it.
- Finite SRS / stratified / grouped frames invert the **hypergeometric** design
  (randomness in the sampling, not the content); multi-cell hypotheses combine
  `Σ_c W_c L_c` with Bonferroni alpha and an exact-0 contribution for
  unmeasured cells. Enriched strata are diagnostics — reported, never
  certification evidence.
- The preregistered gate (versioned `data/eval_confidence.toml` —
  `eval-confidence/1`): family α 0.05 Bonferroni across the tested hypothesis
  family, strict-precision bound ≥ 0.98, `stopping_rule='fixed'`, one scheduled
  analysis. Sealed units, missing labels, contamination, manifest mismatch,
  frozen-digest drift, reused test sets, interim looks, early stops and zero
  samples all fail with named `reasons`.

### Shadow/inactive by construction

- `mode='shadow'` → every report has `applied=()`. Recommendations
  (`certify` / `retain_provisional` / `review_only_fail_safe`) are report
  fields; adopting a demotion is a separate explicit operational decision.
- `activate_policy` refuses `zero_sample`, `no_operational_release`,
  `no_measured_decision` and `policy_shadow_mode` — **this build cannot arm
  the gate.** Arming is the measured post-HUMAN-H5 P32.23 decision.
- `camera_sites.measure_tiers`/`decide_auto_write_tiers` untouched; legacy
  point-gate numbers ride the report labelled `historical_point_gate`.

### Wiring

- `human_eval_pg.eval_units_from_campaign` materializes `EvalUnit`s from
  samples + the **released** label/adjudication views only (sealed units
  materialize `sealed=True, outcome='missing'` and stay in every strict
  denominator; consensus disagreement/insufficient → `unresolved`; stale
  packet digest → `packet_ok=False`).
- `run_shadow_evaluation` recomputes the manifest live and evaluates.
- `sig-resolution eval gate --dsn … --campaign-id … --design design.json
  [--tiers tiers.json] [--format md|json]` prints the digest-stable report.
- `docs/evaluation/shadow-gate-readout.md` documents the readout contract.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] 70/70 agent labels cannot certify the human 0.98 gate — fails on
  provenance AND bound (n=70 all-success peaks at ≈0.958). All-success math
  pinned: **149** needed at α=0.05 one tier (148 fails), **183** at α=0.025 in
  a two-tier Bonferroni family (182 fails) — `test_evaluator.py`.
- [x] Correlated/enriched samples cannot select the unjustified iid method
  (`correlated_units_in_iid_frame`, `iid_requires_*`, `diagnostic_only_design`
  design problems); missing labels reduce strict performance or leave the
  evaluation `incomplete` — never disappear (`drawn` counts them).
- [x] Sealed-test reuse, optional-stopping overrides and zero-sample
  activation fail; deterministic metric vectors pass; independent numerical
  cross-checks use exact `Fraction` binomial tails and a direct `comb`
  hypergeometric scan — separate implementations, not the module under test.
- [x] Verification green; fail-if-removed tests for every new behavior;
  requirement ids stamped here; `D-R6.1-EVAL` advanced-but-OPEN and
  `D-R10-HUMAN-1`/`D-P30.2b-1`/`D-P30.2b-2` annotated OPEN; **ADR-129**;
  ledger/index/run-ledger closeout follows the authorized protocol.

## Deliberately not done

- No promotion or demotion of any production tier — the PROVISIONAL policy is
  untouched; the new gate is report-only until P32.23.
- No human labels/reviewers/campaigns fabricated; `tooling_ready` marker kept.
- No DB migration — the evaluator consumes the existing released views.
- No sequential/alpha-spending monitor — `stopping_rule='fixed'` is the only
  accepted rule; a sequential method needs its own preregistered ADR.
